pages.title: Pulse controls
pages.text: Pulse actions fire on a zero-to-positive signal edge.$(br2)Holding power, changing positive strength or loading an already-powered controller does not create another pulse.

pages.title: Choosing a sound
pages.text: Next plays queued requests before playlist entries.$(br2)Previous selects the previous playlist entry.$(br2)Select Track uses strength 1–15; excess strength selects the last entry.
